history.overview: The Halls were once sacred Dragorn ceremonial chambers, now corrupted by Discord and Muramite occupation.

timeline.name: Ceremonial Era
timeline.description: Dragorn ceremonies and ancestral rites were held in these halls.

timeline.name: Muramite Seizure
timeline.description: Muramite forces seized the halls and converted them into execution chambers.

timeline.name: Discord Sanctum Formation
timeline.description: Discord energy ruptured the deepest sanctum, destabilizing reality.

timeline.name: High Inquisitor Occupation
timeline.description: Muramite high inquisitors established their command within the halls.
